test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Kishore plans to tile his kitchen floor with square tiles. Each side of the tile is 10 cm. The kitchen is 2.4 m long and 1.6 m wide. How many tiles will Kishore need?
solution:
**Given:**

Side of each tile = 10 cm

Length of the kitchen = 2.4 m = 240 cm

Width of the kitchen = 1.6 m = 160 cm

**Formula Used:**

Number of tiles required = (Area of the kitchen floor) / (Area of one tile)

**Calculation:**

Area of the kitchen floor = Length × Width

Area of the kitchen floor = 240 cm × 160 cm

Area of the kitchen floor = 38400 cm²

Area of one tile = Side × Side

Area of one tile = 10 cm × 10 cm

Area of one tile = 100 cm²

Number of tiles required = (Area of the kitchen floor) / (Area of one tile)

Number of tiles required = 38400 cm² / 100 cm²

⇒ Number of tiles required = 384

**The correct answer is option 4.**
